speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Halt, please. Under Security Protocol Two, equipment is issued on referral only, and in this town it is Elder Maren who does the referring.
after: Halt. Security Protocol Two. Equipment is issued on referral only, and Elder Maren does the referring.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Come back when you have Elder Maren's blessing. Better posture is always appreciated, but I regret that it cannot be accepted in its place.
after: Bring Elder Maren's blessing. Better posture is appreciated but cannot be accepted in its place.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Elder Maren sent you, which I could tell from your gait, because it now says 'referred'. Congratulations: your file is finally thick enough to be called a file.
after: Elder Maren sent you; I could tell from your gait, which now says 'referred'. Congratulations. Your file is finally thick enough to be a file.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Before I am permitted to issue gear, protocol requires exactly one thing of you, which is that you win a fight. Any fight counts, and I will know if you lie to me about it.
after: Before I issue gear, protocol requires exactly one thing: win a fight. Any fight counts, and I will know if you lie.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Fact: there are things roaming the outskirts, on the lanes round the edge of town. They are rude and they are close, and not one of them is on my referral list.
after: Fact: things roam the outskirts, on the lanes round the edge of town. They are rude, they are close, and they are not on my referral list.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Beat one of them and then come back to me, and I will hand you something pointy.
after: Beat one. Then come back and I will hand you something pointy.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: I will be here in the meantime, guarding the drawer. The drawer does not know that it is being guarded, and that is the whole point.
after: I will be here, guarding the drawer. The drawer does not know. That is the point.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth
before: Security Protocol Nine: gear in a bag protects nobody, so please equip it.
after: Security Protocol Nine: gear in a bag protects nobody. Equip it.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth
before: Press C, click the Weapon slot on the figure, choose the blade and press Equip. That is four steps, and I have written them down for you, in my head.
after: Press C, click the Weapon slot on the figure, choose the blade and press Equip. Four steps. I have written them down for you, in my head.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth
before: Please be aware that unequipped gear will be noted in your file, and that your file is already very thick.
after: Unequipped gear will be noted in your file. Your file is already very thick.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth
before: The blade is still in the bag. I can see the bag from here, and I have reason to believe that the bag can see me.
after: The blade is still in the bag. I can see the bag. The bag can see me.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth
before: Menu, then Character, then the Weapon slot, then Equip. Security Protocol Nine does not repeat itself, so I am repeating it for you as a personal courtesy.
after: Menu. Character. Weapon slot. Equip. Security Protocol Nine does not repeat itself. I am repeating it for you as a courtesy.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Security Protocol Twelve: report to Elder Maren when we are finished here, because she is the one who decides where things get pointed.
after: Security Protocol Twelve: report to Elder Maren. She decides where things get pointed.

speaker: Bertram Beetsworth, Assistant to the Regional Merchant
before: Here is your Starter Blade. With it, the first unit you play each battle hits a little harder. Protocol also requires me to say: do not run with it.
after: Your Starter Blade. The first unit you play each battle hits a little harder. Do not run with it.
